g.text: 1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN mm AND DEGREES. EVERY DIMENSION AND

Y=-6.099 Z=16.500 — MEASURED OVER THE WHOLE SOLID BY
RAY+EXACT AT 1.409 mm SAMPLE SPACING (A FEATURE

DISTANCE THROUGH MATERIAL AND IS NOT A PRINTABLE WALL.
OTHERWISE STATED, DERIVED FROM THE DECLARED PROCESS.
